documents.title: Tech Mahindra Limited Has informed About Newspaper Advertisement Published Regarding The Notice Of Loss Of Share Certificates
Outcome And Audio Recording Of Quarterly Earnings Conference Call

analysis.summary: Tech Mahindra reported a strong Q2 FY27 with revenue at $1.693 billion, representing 6.8% year-on-year reported growth and 7.2% constant currency growth, alongside operating margins of 14.8%. Total deal wins for the quarter stood at $1.023 billion, and the board recommended a 1:1 bonus share issue and an interim dividend of INR 15 per share. Management highlighted broad-based growth across verticals, expanding traction in AI initiatives under TechM Helix, and reiterated its target to achieve a full-year FY27 EBIT margin of 15%. Tech Mahindra reported its audited consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, registering consolidated revenue of Rs. 16,180 crores and a profit after tax of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company reiterated its expectation to achieve its full-year FY27 EBIT margin target of 15%.
guidance.quote: We reiterate that we remain on track to achieve our full-year FY27 EBIT margin target of 15%.

guidance.claim: The management reiterated its stance to maintain 90% to 100% free cash flow to PAT on a full-year basis.
guidance.quote: We reiterate our stance to maintain 90% to 100% free cash flow to PAT on a full-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident that the company will meet or exceed its goal of being ahead of the peer average for the full financial year.
guidance.quote: On the whole, we feel we have a healthy order book for the remainder of the year, and barring any sort of unexpected and so far unforeseen macroeconomic developments, we remain confident that the growth momentum that we have set in the first quarter of the year will continue for the remainder of the year and that we will, you know, we will meet or exceed our goal of being ahead of peer average for the full financial year, as we already are in the first quarter of the financial year.

guidance.claim: The company expects operating margins to be upwards of 15% for the fourth quarter.
guidance.quote: We've not articulated that, but I mean if you look at Q1, we're at 14.4%, and as we move forward incrementally, as I mentioned, we'll keep on improving margins, so it has to be upwards of 15% for the fourth quarter, and we'll see how each quarter progresses from here and now.

demand_outlook.claim: The management expects normal seasonality for the second half of the year.
The company continues to see some weaknesses in its European auto manufacturing business.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to see some weaknesses in our European auto manufacturing business, but those are all manageable within the existing portfolio that we have.

demand_outlook.claim: The BFSI business continues to see healthy demand in areas such as payment modernization, wealth platforms, regulatory compliance, identity and access management, and AI-led transformation.
demand_outlook.quote: Our BFSI business grew 8.1% year-on-year. We continue to see healthy demand in areas such as payment modernization, wealth platforms, regulatory compliance, identity and access management, and AI-led transformation.

demand_outlook.claim: Payments modernization, particularly real-time payment rails and cloud-native transformation, is expected to grow faster than traditional IT services.
demand_outlook.quote: Payments modernization, particularly real-time payment rails and cloud-native transformation, is expected to grow faster than traditional IT services.

demand_outlook.claim: In the manufacturing vertical, the company continues to see strong client interest in intelligent, data-driven operations that bring together AI, data platforms, engineering, and enterprise systems at scale.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to see strong client interest in intelligent, data-driven operations that bring together AI, data platforms, engineering, and enterprise systems at scale.

demand_outlook.claim: While the macroeconomic environment for the retail, travel, and logistics vertical remains mixed, tailored offerings and focused client engagement are gaining traction.
demand_outlook.quote: While the macroeconomic environment for this vertical remains mixed, our tailored offerings and focused client engagement approach are gaining traction and we remain positive about the direction of the business.

demand_outlook.claim: In healthcare, the company is seeing opportunities in vendor consolidation and AI-led discretionary spend.
demand_outlook.quote: Our healthcare business grew 7.2% year-on-year, supported by momentum across providers and life sciences. We are seeing opportunities in vendor consolidation and AI-led discretionary spend.

capex_expansion.claim: During the quarter, the company announced the acquisition of Avant Techno Solutions, a Canada-based firm specializing in payments modernization and wealth platforms.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we also announced the acquisition of Avant Techno Solutions, a Canada-based firm specializing in payments modernization and wealth platforms.

margins_costs.claim: Operating margins for the quarter stood at 14.8%.
margins_costs.quote: Operating margins for the quarter stood at 14.8%.

margins_costs.claim: The margin improvement was driven by strong volume growth and Project Fortius savings, which were partially offset by wage hikes.
margins_costs.quote: The margin improvement was driven by strong volume growth and Project Fortius savings, partially offset by the wage hikes.

margins_costs.claim: EBIT margin was 14.8%, up by approximately 40 bps QoQ and 260 bps YoY.
margins_costs.quote: • EBIT Margin 14.8%, up ~40 bps QoQ, up ~260 bps YoY

margins_costs.claim: Margins expanded for the twelfth consecutive quarter.
margins_costs.quote: “We delivered another strong quarter of growth, with margins expanding for the twelfth consecutive quarter, reflecting disciplined execution.

margins_costs.claim: Operating margins for the quarter stood at 14.4%, up 60 bps quarter-on-quarter and 330 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Operating margins stood at 14.4%, reflecting sustained execution discipline, operational rigor, and a continuous focus on profitable growth.

margins_costs.claim: Margin expansion was driven by volume growth and savings from Project Fortius, partially offset by Comviva seasonality and business mix.
margins_costs.quote: EBIT margins for the quarter were at US$238 million with EBIT percent at 14.4%, up 60 bps Q-o-Q and 330 basis points Y-o-Y. The margin expansion was led by volume growth and savings from Project Fortius, partially offset by Comviva seasonality and business mix.

orders_capacity.claim: Total deal wins for the quarter were US$1.023 billion.
orders_capacity.quote: Coming to deal wins, our total deal wins for the quarter were US$1.023 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: On a last-12-month basis, deal wins stand at US$4,270 million, up 34.8% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: On a last-12-month basis, deal wins stand at US$4,270 million, up 34.8% Y-o-Y.

orders_capacity.claim: New deal wins TCV stood at $1,023 million, up 25.4% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: • New deal wins TCV $1,023 mn, up 25.4% YoY

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a bonus share issue in a ratio of 1:1 for shareholders.
capital_allocation.quote: As we mark this milestone, I'm also pleased to announce that our Board of Directors has recommended a bonus share issue in a ratio of 1:1 for our shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: The board declared an interim dividend of INR 15 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: The board has declared an interim dividend of INR15 per share, reaffirming our commitment to the laid-out capital allocation policy of returning 85% and above of free cash flow back to shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended the issue of bonus equity shares in the ratio of 1:1.
capital_allocation.quote: Issue of Bonus Equity Shares in the ratio of 1:1, i.e. one (1) new fully paid-up Bonus Equity Share of Rs. 5/- each for every one (1) existing fully paid-up equity share of Rs. 5/- each

capital_allocation.claim: Authorised share capital is proposed to be increased from Rs. 924.3 crore to Rs. 1,000 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Increase in the Authorised Share Capital of the Company from Rs. 924.3 crore to Rs. 1,000 crore, and consequent amendment to the existing Clause V(a) of the Memorandum of Association of the Company.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated US$167 million of free cash flow during the quarter, up 94% year-on-year.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated US$167 million of free cash flow during the quarter, up 94% on a Y-o-Y basis.

capital_allocation.claim: Return on capital employed stood at 28.3% for the quarter, reflecting a sequential improvement of 210 basis points.
capital_allocation.quote: Our return on capital employed stood at 28.3% for the quarter, reflecting a sequential improvement of 210 basis points.

risks_headwinds.claim: A sequential revenue headwind associated with the European automotive program is expected in Q3 as well.
risks_headwinds.quote: A sequential revenue headwind associated with the program is expected in Q3 as well, though to a much smaller extent.

risks_headwinds.claim: The communications business experienced headwinds from Comviva seasonality and a one-time cloud consumption transition.
risks_headwinds.quote: So I think these were the two headwinds for us coming into Comms for Q1, but despite that, we've delivered, you know, we've delivered a positive year-on-year growth number.

risks_headwinds.claim: The European auto segment had accelerated program deliveries in the quarter, which will create downward pressure and a slowdown for the next quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: The one sort of headwind that we will have is the fact that we had a one-off in our European auto business in this quarter, which will show some signs of slowdown then in Q2.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to introduce AI revenue reporting as part of its H2 FY27 disclosures.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to introduce AI revenue reporting as part of our H2 FY27 disclosures and continue it on an ongoing basis, refining the methodology as our portfolio and the markets mature.

management_commitments.claim: Completion of the middleware development for India's indigenous 20-qubit trapped-ion quantum computer is expected by December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Completion is expected by December 2026, with commercialization activities expected thereafter.

management_commitments.claim: The interim dividend shall be paid by 13 November 2026 through electronic mode.
management_commitments.quote: The Interim Dividend shall be paid by 13 November 2026 through electronic mode to those Members or their mandates:

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to roll out wage increases effective Q2 in a phased fashion.
management_commitments.quote: As far as the wage piece is concerned, we expect to be able to announce it effective Q2, obviously in a phased fashion which we will be announcing, to our employees in the days to come, so that will be effective, it'll start becoming effective Q2 in a phased fashion.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
